source_repository: original mlx2 code; no external source mined
informed_by: provenance/lane-matmul.json (TensorFold bb4b4a35 lane_qmm, MIT): the lane matmul and its same-name sibling stacking, which this extends
provenance/tensorfold-prefill.json (TensorFold 71377a53 prefill_mm, MIT): the idea of grouping every projection that reads one prefill input
modifications: ProjectionGroup(name, parent class, member paths): adapter-declared stacking of projections that one __call__ feeds the same tensor object, including list-indexed members (lmk_q_proj.0). The scheduler and cache see only the adapter hook lane_projection_groups(); there is no model-name branch.

Declared groups form before the same-name defaults, only on modules of exactly the parent class, and only whole: every member covered, ungrouped and of one weight format. Otherwise nothing of the group is stacked and the default groups apply unchanged.

Selected by lane policy key declared_groups (default false). When any declared group forms the law id gains +declared[<names>@<sha256 of the formed specs>], because a wider stack changes split-K for every member. Off, law ids and groups are byte-identical to before.
Selected but undeliverable (adapter declares none, or none forms) uninstalls the lane and fails startup. declared_groups without grouping fails policy resolution.

Per-group counters declared_launches/declared_reuses/declared_partial (a launch that served only part of its group because members saw different tensor objects); /v1/status lane_matmul.declared_groups and mlx2_lane_matmul_declared_group_events_total.

Groups: muse-attn-qkv-gate (Muse Attention q/k/v + output gate), hils-attn-qkv-lmkq (HiLSAttention q/k/v + lmk_q_proj.0), xing-mla-qa-kva (Xing4_0Attention q_a_proj + kv_a_proj_with_mqa) and xing-mla-q-kva (q_proj variant for a config without a query LoRA; no shipped artifact).
